title: Approximate tangent spaces are unchanged by zero-density modifications (pointwise Simon Ch. 3, Remark 1.5(2))
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, Hⁿ = μHE[n] on ℝ^{n+ℓ} (= Amb n ℓ), A, N ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} Borel sets with Hⁿ(A) < ∞ and Hⁿ(N) < ∞, x ∈ ℝ^{n+ℓ}, and Q a linear subspace of ℝ^{n+ℓ}. Suppose Hⁿ((A ∖ N) ∩ B_r(x))/rⁿ → 0 and Hⁿ((N ∖ A) ∩ B_r(x))/rⁿ → 0 in [0, ∞] as r ↓ 0 (B_r(x) closed ball, rⁿ read as ENNReal.ofReal (rⁿ)), and Q is the approximate tangent space of N at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, Def. 1.4 (Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x Q: finrank Q = n and ∫_{η_{x,r}(N)} f dHⁿ → ∫_Q f dHⁿ as r ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^{n+ℓ}, ℝ)). Then Q is the approximate tangent space of A at x (Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (A N : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (x : Amb n ℓ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet N → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) A < ⊤ → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) N < ⊤ → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) ((A \ N) ∩ closedBall x r) / ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) ((N \ A) ∩ closedBall x r) / ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x Q → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q
